fullDesc: The Nasdaq Composite peaked above 5,000 on March 10, 2000, after a boom in internet companies. It then fell about 78 percent by October 2002, and many dot-com firms went bankrupt.
realFacts: Pets.com became a symbol of the excess
It took until 2015 for the Nasdaq to regain its peak
The bust cleared the way for a later tech wave
